overview_description.description: Root Insurance is a property-casualty insurtech that offers personalized, affordable coverage in an app. Using technology in smartphones to measure driving behavior such as braking, speed of turns, driving times, and route regularity, Root determines who is a safe driver and who isn't. By only insuring safe drivers, Root can offer more affordable car insurance rates. Root also offers hassle-free and affordable app-based renters insurance, providing coverage that’s easy to understand and is personalized around real consumer needs.

product.name: Root Car Insurance
product.description: A car insurance policy with rates primarily based on actual driving behavior measured via a smartphone app.

product.name: Root Mobile Application
product.description: A smartphone app that collects driving data, provides insurance quotes, manages policies, and facilitates claims filing.

product.name: Roadside Assistance
product.description: An optional service providing coverage for towing, jump starts, and lockout assistance for insured vehicles.

product.name: Claims Management Service
product.description: A service that allows policyholders to file and manage auto insurance claims quickly through the Root app or online.

product.name: Referral Program
product.description: A program that rewards existing policyholders for referring new drivers who complete the test drive and receive a quote.

product.name: Renters Insurance
product.description: An insurance policy that protects personal property for renters, available as a bundle with car insurance.
